OrganizationCreateRequest.description: The alias, display name and description of the organization to create. The identifier is generated.

alias.description: The organization's public alias: a lower-case slug of 3 to 63 letters, digits and dashes, beginning with a letter or a digit. It is unique across the roster and cannot be changed after creation.

description.description: The organization's description; at most 500 runes after trimming.

display_name.description: The organization's display name; 1 to 100 runes after trimming, and the surface requires it non-empty.

OrganizationCreatedTenant.description: The created organization: the caller's alias and profile, and the active state. The generated identifier is internal and never appears.

alias.description: The request-surface name the caller chose; unique across the roster and immutable after creation.

status.description: The organization's state; a self-service organization starts active.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

post.description: Creates one active business organization for the calling account through the provisioning seam: the caller becomes its first tenant-admin, the tenant-admin role is marked builtin and carries the governed permission set. The caller chooses the alias; the identifier is generated and stays internal. A pending email address is refused (contact-required); an impersonating caller, a service account and a static subject are refused. The alias is held to the roster's slug form, the reserved-name set and one namespace with usernames and tenant identifiers. A per-account lock, the active-business-organization cap and the hourly creation limit bound the call, and a mandatory audit row must land before the provisioner runs.

requestBody.description: The alias, display name and description of the organization; the identifier is generated.

400.description: The alias or display name is missing or outside its bounds, or the alias is reserved

403.description: The caller is impersonating, is a service account or a static subject, or has not proved an email address (contact-required)

409.description: The caller cannot create an organization now: a creation is already in progress (creation-in-progress), the account holds the maximum number of active business organizations (organization-limit), or the alias or generated identifier is unavailable (identifier-unavailable). The type field names which

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

429.description: The account has reached the hourly creation limit; Retry-After names the seconds until the next window

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds until the hourly window opens again

503.description: A dependency could not answer; no part of the organization is created
